notes.note: Re-recorded after the new chat draft's model-picker focus fix (src-ui/src/components/modals/NewChatModal.tsx). ModelPickerDialogFrame gained an optional returnFocusTarget read once at mount and passed through SessionModelPicker; NewChatModal records the control that opened the picker and passes it to both the loading frame and the real one; tests/task-first-home.spec.ts asserts focus returns to the draft's Model chip on close. I searched this document for model-picker, focus, return-focus and close behaviour: it states no claim about where focus goes when the picker closes, so nothing it says changes.
